subject: well
text: Shooting the eye switch inside the well drains the water, allowing access to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
In this other grassy room, kill all the enemies here, then look down the well
here for an eye switch. Shoot it to drain the well, and head down it. Open the
chest for a Small Key.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located down in the trench on the other side of the drained well.

evidence.quote:
Walk clear over to the other side and look down at the
trench to see a Gold Skulltula. Kill it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located right next to the Hookshot mark above the entrance door in the grassy room.

evidence.quote:
Now, look up above the door you 
entered. See the Hookshot mark? There's a Gold Skulltula right next to it. Kill
it and pull yourself up there.

subject: alcove
text: Climbing the vines past the Skullwalltula leads to an alcove with a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
On the last one, look up and kill the 
Skullwalltula, and Hookshot onto the vines. Climb up into the alcove and open
the chest for another Small Key.

subject: checkered floor room
text: Stepping on one of the switches in the falling ceiling room makes a treasure chest containing a bundle of Arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
There are two
switches and a locked door at the end. One switch opens another door back where
you fell down here, and the other makes a treasure chest appear. Open that for
a bundle of Arrows.

subject: chest
text: Dropping down through the opened door past the falling ceiling room leads to a Deku Baba and a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Now head through that door that was opened. Drop down 
gently, kill the Deku Baba, and open the chest for a Small Key.

subject: Yellow Poe
text: Pushing the blocks to replicate the portrait within a minute causes the Yellow Poe to appear.

evidence.quote:
In this
room, shoot the portrait, then push the blocks so that the top of the blocks
replicate the portrait. Successfully doing that within a minute will make the
Yellow Poe appear.

subject: Meg
text: The real Poe sister among the clones can be identified and shot because she spins as soon as she clones herself.

evidence.quote:
Kill the last Poe by shooting the right one (the one that spins as
soon as she clones herself) and once she's gone, you'll be able to take the
elevator down, so take it.

subject: rotating room
text: A small chest in the rotating room beneath the elevator contains a bundle of arrows.

evidence.quote: - There is a small chest containing a bundle of arrows.

subject: Green Potions
text: Bringing at least one or two Green Potions into the Fire Temple is recommended due to heavy Din's Fire usage depleting magic.

evidence.quote:
NOTE: Before entering, make sure you brought at least one or two Green Potions.
You're going to be using Din's Fire a lot, and the small magic bar you have 
just won't stay filled.

subject: Like Like
text: If a Like Like swallows Link and steals the Goron Tunic and Hylian Shield, killing it returns the Tunic and spawns a chest with the Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote:
If it does, it will take 
your Goron Tunic AND Hylian Shield. If this happens, quickly kill the Like Like
to get your Tunic back, and open the chest that appears for the Hylian Shield.

subject: jail cell
text: Lighting the torches with Din's Fire and a fire arrow opens a jail cell containing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
If done
fast enough, the jail cell at that other side will open. Climb the ledges to be
able to jump back, and go on that side. Open the chest there for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: An Iron Knuckle can be defeated easily by backflipping away when it is ready to slash, then landing a jump strike followed by another backflip.

evidence.quote:
To kill it easily, just approach it, and
when it's ready to slash, backflip. Once clear, jump strike then backflip. 
Repeat.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: The Hookshot can be used to pull off the Flare Dancer's clothes, allowing it to be killed with Advanced Spin Slashes.

evidence.quote:
You'll fight a Flare Dancer next. Just use the Hookshot to rip its clothes off,
then kill it with Advanced Spin Slashes.

subject: pedestal
text: Defeating the Flare Dancer spawns a chest on a pedestal containing the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
Once it's killed, the door ahead will
open and a chest will appear on the pedestal. Open it for the MEGATON HAMMER.

subject: Goron jail
text: Pounding the rusted switch with the Megaton Hammer frees a Goron and grants access to a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Pound the rusted switch with your shiny new 
item to open the gate ahead. Talk to the Goron to set him free, then open the
chest that was next to him to get the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located past the rusted switch at the end of the short northern hallway in the large room.

evidence.quote:
At the
end of the short hall is a rusted switch. Pound it, free the Goron, and kill 
the Gold Skulltula there.

subject: jail cell
text: Bombing the discolored wall and lighting the torch with Din's Fire frees a Goron and reveals a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the discolored wall here and open the door. Use Din's Fire to 
light the other torch here, free the Goron, and open the chest for a Small Key.

subject: fire alcove
text: Hookshotting to the torch behind the fire barrier grants access to a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Hookshot into there using the torch, and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: jail cell
text: Breaking the lone crate without small boxes on top inside the southern jail cell reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Break the
only crate that doesn't have small boxes on them to reveal a small chest. Open
it for some Bombs.

subject: hall
text: Stepping on the switch behind the blue switch door frees a Goron and allows opening a chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Step
on the switch in this hall, free the Goron, and open the chest for a Small Key.

subject: cracked floor alcove
text: Dropping through the bombed floor crack in the maze walls leads to a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Bomb it and drop down. Break all the crates down here until you find a rusted
switch. Pound it to open cages both down here and back up in the maze room.
Climb back up after grabbing the COMPASS from the chest down here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Pulling the block away after temporarily putting out the fire reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be killed and collected with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Drop down back to that switch,
step on it, then Hookshot back up. The fire is out. Pull the block away and 
kill the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot, as the fire will be back shortly.
Get the token with the Hookshot as well.

subject: southern cell
text: Opening the cage in the southern cell with an Advanced Spin Slash and breaking crates reveals a chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Go to the 
cell to the south, and use an Advanced Spin Slash to open the cage. Break the
crates to find a treasure chest. Open it for some Bombs.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the weak wall in the alcove of the southern hall reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In this little hall, bomb the weak wall in the
alcove down here to find a Gold Skulltula. Kill it, then head back.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the northern room past the fire barrier after moving the blue block with the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: Climb up to itand jump over the fire. Enter the door down here, kill the Lizalfos, and get the Gold Skulltula.

subject: rising platform
text: Jumping off the rising platform immediately after defeating the Flare Dancer allows Link to grab a Small Key underneath.

evidence.quote:
Once it's killed, get on the platform to make it rise, then immediately jump
off so you can grab the Small Key underneath.

subject: flaming treasure chest
text: Stepping on the switch and Hookshotting back up to the scarecrow allows Link to open the chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Jump
down to the switch, step on it, then Hookshot back up. Open the chest for a
Small Key.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Hookshotting the face on the wall opens the door to the final Gold Skulltula in the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot the face on the wall to open the door, enter it, and find the last 
Gold Skulltula in this temple.

subject: red ice structure
text: Hitting the crystal switch beneath the Skullwalltula spawns a chest inside red ice that yields the Dungeon Map when melted with Blue Fire.

evidence.quote:
Hit that switch to make a treasure chest appear
inside the red ice structure. Drop the Blue Fire onto the red ice to melt it,
and open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Freezard ledge
text: Defeating the Freezard on the upper ledge reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Go over to the Freezard, kill it, then open the chest it
was guarding for the COMPASS.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Summoning two blue blocks with the Song of Time allows Link to drop Blue Fire onto the red ice encasing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of Time to make a blue block appear. Stand on it, then play
the Song of Time again to make another blue block appear. Stand on that, then
drop the Blue Fire on the red ice. Kill the Gold Skulltula.
